children: European natural-gas prices rise in early trading as market focus remains on storage levels ahead of the winter heating season. The benchmark Dutch TTF contract gains 3% to 74 euros a megawatt-hour with diplomatic talks between the U.S. and Iran showing little sign of meaningful progress, adding to uncertainty over the broader energy outlook. According to industry group Gas Infrastructure Europe, inventories across the European Union are currently 70% full, well below the seasonal average of 86%. "Higher LNG flows to northwest Europe have offered some relief, but lower Norwegian pipeline flows amid heavy maintenance continue to limit the buffer," analysts at ANZ say. (giulia.petroni@wsj.com)
